title: Multi-Component Platform (MCP)
summary: This module provides core functionalities for implementing and interacting with the Model Context Protocol (MCP). It includes components for serving MCP requests, loading MCP-based toolsets and servers from configurations, and defining MCP resources.

nodes.label: MCP HTTP Server
nodes.title: MCP HTTP Server (SSE)
nodes.description: Implements the Model Context Protocol (MCP) server using Server-Sent Events (SSE) over HTTP, enabling communication with external MCP clients. It handles incoming requests and dispatches them for processing.

nodes.label: Handle MCP Requests
nodes.title: MCP Request Handler
nodes.description: Processes incoming MCP sampling messages and parameters, constructs model settings, and orchestrates calls to underlying AI models to generate responses. It maps between MCP and internal AI model formats.

nodes.label: Load MCP Toolsets
nodes.title: Load Toolsets from Config
nodes.description: Parses a configuration file to load and instantiate MCP toolsets. Each server entry in the config generates a prefixed toolset, allowing integration of external MCP services as tools within the AI framework.

nodes.label: Load MCP Servers
nodes.title: Load Servers from Config
nodes.description: Reads a configuration file to define and load MCP server instances, including HTTP and standard I/O servers. It handles environment variable expansion and validates the configuration against the MCP schema.

nodes.label: Define MCP Resource
nodes.title: MCP Resource Definition
nodes.description: Represents a concrete resource available on an MCP server, including its URI, size, MIME type, and metadata. It facilitates structured access and description of data assets for AI models.

nodes.label: Define Resource Template
nodes.title: MCP Resource Template
nodes.description: Defines a template for parameterized resources on an MCP server, using URI templates (RFC 6570). This allows for dynamic generation of resource URIs based on specific parameters, enhancing flexibility.

nodes.label: AI Models
nodes.title: AI Model Providers
nodes.description: External module providing various AI model implementations and wrappers, used by the MCP request handler to generate responses based on processed inputs.

nodes.label: Configuration File
nodes.title: MCP Configuration
nodes.description: JSON configuration file specifying MCP server details, including transport types (HTTP, Stdio) and associated parameters. Used to dynamically set up MCP servers and toolsets.

groups.label: MCP Server Infrastructure
groups.title: MCP Server Infrastructure
groups.description: Components responsible for setting up and managing MCP servers and their communication protocols.

groups.label: MCP Toolset Management
groups.title: MCP Toolset Management
groups.description: Handles the dynamic loading and integration of external MCP services as callable toolsets within the AI framework.

groups.label: MCP Request Processing
groups.title: MCP Request Processing
groups.description: Manages the parsing of incoming MCP messages and orchestrates the generation of AI model responses.

groups.label: MCP Resource Definitions
groups.title: MCP Resource Definitions
groups.description: Defines the structure and templating mechanisms for resources exposed or consumed by MCP servers.
